description: The only capability of the Scríobh desktop shell, and it grants nothing. It names the shell's windows so that the list of what a page may ask of the shell is written down and is empty. It has no `remote` entry, so a page loaded from http://127.0.0.1 is outside every capability. src-tauri/tests/lockdown.rs fails if a permission or a remote origin is ever added here.
